description: This script is a Python program that introduces small randomized inaccuracies into subtitle (.srt) files within a specific directory. It backs up original files, modifies subtitle blocks by removing words, replacing words with similar-looking variants, or shifting subtitle timings, and generates reports. It is designed to be idempotent and safe, with markers to prevent reprocessing.

classes.name: SrtBlock
classes.description: A data class representing a parsed subtitle block with index, start/end times in milliseconds, and text lines.

methods.name: process_srt_file
methods.description: Processes a single SRT file: backs up, injects inaccuracies, updates the file, and produces a report.

methods.name: process_subtitle_directory
methods.description: Scans a directory for .srt files and processes each one.

methods.name: main
methods.description: CLI entry point that determines the subtitle directory and initiates processing.
